summary.value: As part of any Accuracy Check, or when invoked by Perfect Guard, spend 5 MP to swap the ranges of your equipped one-hand

system.description: As part of any Accuracy Check, or when invoked by Perfect Guard, spend 5 MP to swap the ranges of your equipped one-handed weapons (melee become thrown ranged, ranged become brawling melee); this ends on a weapon after its first use resolves. Once per round after you deal ranged damage, your next melee attack deals +(SL) damage, and vice versa.
